correctness.rationale: For the exact support family h=1+tY in n=10, the spherical Hessian eigenvalues give strict support convexity for |t|<56/143. The volume-radius factors of the two affine quermassintegrals cancel exactly. Line projection volumes are 1+tY, while 2-plane projection areas are exactly 1+2ta+t²d by the planar support-area identity. Haar plane directions yield z~Beta(1,4); sphere directions yield s²~Beta(1/2,9/2). Evaluating their exact moments gives M2 quadratic/cubic coefficients twice M1, and the positive fourth-order logarithmic coefficient 139863/3147038720. Uniform positivity over compact Grassmannians justifies Taylor remainders and strict sign for sufficiently small nonzero t. Standalone rational polynomial verification passed. No wider inequality or explicit universal t threshold is asserted.
